$description: MetalUI components. Each has a React export, a SwiftUI symbol, a shadcn registry item and an agent guide.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Sections that open in place: row headers with a chevron; the panel grows to its content on the settle spring while the shared chevron morphs from right to down on settle, and leaves on release.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert dialog
components.description: A question that must be answered: the dialog's plate and motion; a click outside shakes it once on the refusal spring instead of closing it, and focus starts on Cancel.

components.name: attachment
components.title: Attachment
components.description: A file someone attached, as a small raised plate: type, name, size or an explicit upload receipt; shared glyphs morph from upload to check only after host confirmation. It lands on the object spring when added, fills while uploading, says when it failed, and leaves on release when removed.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A person as a small raised disc: initials, or a photo that fades in once loaded; presence as the LED; a group overlaps and spreads apart on the object spring when hovered.

components.name: block-silhouette
components.title: Block silhouette
components.description: A block seen from far away: below the far-zoom threshold the canvas draws one flat, cheap shape per block that still says its kind (text bars, a dark code card, a link's tinted glass, a colour, a light file plate, a region's tray and name).

react.base: none (decorative; aria-hidden: the canvas announces the blocks, not their silhouettes)

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.title: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Where you are, as a path you can climb: levels above in ink2, the current in ink, engraved chevrons between; a new level arrives from the right on the settle spring; long paths fold the middle into a menu.

components.name: brush-cursor
components.title: Brush cursor
components.description: The pointer while drawing or erasing: a disc in the ink colour at the stroke width times the zoom, or a dashed ring the size of what the eraser removes; it follows the pointer in the same frame.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A press-in pill button with compact caps, async waiting/result faces and opt-in irreversible hold confirmation. React on Base UI and SwiftUI share recipes and timing.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button group
components.description: Related action segments cut from one raised bar with engraved seams, independent presses and noninteractive readout windows. SplitButton shares one cap material with a held menu segment.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A calendar for single dates, inclusive ranges and independent dates. Localized segmented date entry, eligibility and form validation share the same selection; date and time can be displayed in an IANA time zone.

react.base: table role=grid (the ARIA date grid pattern); Popover

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A person's thing on a raised plate: media, title, a line, actions. A card with a link lifts one grid step on the settle spring as its shadow grows; a card that goes nowhere is still.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: The dimple checkbox: a recessed well that turns into a dark pressed key with a drawn tick; doing (half green) and ghost (an inferred task's hollow ring) states.

components.name: checkbox-group
components.title: Checkbox group
components.description: Several independent choices in a form: row-size checkboxes with labels and an optional parent; ticking the parent ticks its rows in a cascade from the top, clearing clears them at once.

components.name: chip
components.title: Chip
components.description: A small pill with an optional leading LED or glyph and trailing actions: suggestion, glass, glass-action and tag.

components.name: code-card
components.title: Code card
components.description: Code as a glass object: numbered, tinted lines (at most 18) on a dark screen under a CODE · LANG · N LINES tag.

components.name: colour-cue
components.title: Colour cue
components.description: A fixed-footprint six-digit colour word opens the shared hue well and rewrites source through one gesture transaction.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: Type to find one of many: a field well that opens the menu's frosted plate; rows filter at once while the plate's height settles to the new count, and the highlight glides row to row.

components.name: command-palette
components.title: Command palette
components.description: ⌘K: a 560 frost plate with a 44 field well, sections of 36 rows with matches marked, a raised selected row with a green bar, destructive rows in red, and a footer of keycaps. Hover moves the selection; ↩ runs, ⇧↩ pins. Built on Base UI Dialog and an inline Combobox.

components.name: connector
components.title: Connector
components.description: The look around ink that joins two blocks: a green halo and end dots on hover (solid attached, hollow free), end handles when selected, and a label chip at the middle; same size on screen at every zoom.

components.name: date-cue
components.title: Date cue
components.description: An inline civil date: day/week detents, nearby relative source words, a resolved date and a Calendar opened by hold or keyboard. Explicit today, bounds and footprint keep date/source semantics stable.

components.name: day
components.title: Day
components.description: The day as an object: a tear-off page with the date in dots, the month, weekday and clock in the pixel face, the minute filling along its foot; the year so far one dot a day, the days left and the moon; one line for the day. Tap the page to tear it off. And a small tile of the date.

react.base: none (a region; tearing is one real button)

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal layer: a scrim behind a surface; focus stays inside, Escape and a click outside close it.

components.name: dot-display
components.title: Dot display
components.description: Square dots on one pitch, printed into a well: each dot one px colour or unlit. A slow display that steps six times a second and never tweens. The picture (a sky, a sticker) is the caller's.

components.name: draw-picks
components.title: Draw picks
components.description: The ink and width choices in the drawing group: five glossy ink beads and three width dots in the current ink; the chosen one sits in a sunk well like a latched tool.

components.name: draw-tools
components.title: Draw tools
components.description: The drawing group of the toolbar: eight tool caps (pen, pencil, marker, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, eraser) with one latched, then the five inks and three widths.

components.name: drop-zone
components.title: Drop zone
components.description: A place that receives files, by drop or by picking: a sunk tray whose edge lights while files are dragged in the window, sinks and says 'Let go to attach' with files over it, refuses a file it won't take with a shake, and comes back up on the object spring when they land.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty state
components.description: A place with nothing in it yet: an engraved glyph in a well, what would be here, how to start, one action; it rises in on the settle spring when the place empties.

components.name: enum-cue
components.title: Enum cue
components.description: A finite host-declared source state: cycle, keyboard step, focused wheel or held vertical drag with one source/history transaction and a fixed footprint.

components.name: fan
components.title: Fan
components.description: A compact canvas control bar: grouped tools unfold in a three-column grid, contextual glyph actions expand in a tray, and named ink and stroke keys latch the current settings. One cell opens at a time.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Text input in a well with a leading glyph and trailing keycaps; SearchField, a button in a well that opens search.

components.name: filter-bar
components.title: Filter bar
components.description: Names the question a filter asks and switches how the answer is shown: Surface(frost) with a Glyph, the query in Label(query), the count and source engraved, a compact Switcher of views, and IconButton(ghost) pin and close. Formerly LensBar.

components.name: folder
components.title: Folder
components.description: A folder on the canvas that holds blocks: a back panel with a tab, up to three blocks peeking up as cards, a frosted flap with its name and count; fans on hover, opens wide when a block is dragged over, swings shut when one lands; six paper colours.

components.name: form-field
components.title: Form field
components.description: A control with its words: label, description and an error that grows open from under the control on the settle spring; invalid and disabled reach every control inside. Fieldset groups fields under a legend.

components.name: glass-face
components.title: Glass face
components.description: A dark glass object: a bezel around a screen with a glare, a shaded rim and an inner shadow.

components.name: glyph
components.title: Glyph
components.description: A static icon at a size (10, 14, 16) in an ink (ink, ink2, ink3, inherit); decorative.

components.name: hover-engraving
components.title: Hover engraving
components.description: A block's identity on a 420 ms dwell: Surface(tip) beside its first line with the kind and details in Label(engraved), derived tags as Chip(tag) and the recognizer's status with a Led.

react.base: none (a note on its block; the block points aria-describedby at it)

components.name: icon-button
components.title: Icon button
components.description: A pressable cap with only a glyph: tool (a graphite cap that latches with a green LED), ghost (flat, round) and mini (inside a chip).

components.name: kbd
components.title: Keycap
components.description: A key's glyph on a small raised cap, in the readout role: 20 tall (16 in a footer), on a light surface, a graphite strip, or sunk into a toast's Undo.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Text in a set role: engraved, small, title, heading, query, count, cell, value, display, readout, on-graphite and dark; as="input" edits in place.

components.name: lasso
components.title: Lasso
components.description: The box a drag on empty canvas draws: a 1 pt intent-green hairline over a faint fill, and a graphite readout under it counting what it will select (● 3 blocks). The same on screen at every zoom.

react.base: none (decorative; aria-hidden: the selection it makes is announced)

components.name: led
components.title: LED
components.description: An 8pt lens in an opaque 1pt socket, beside words. Five shared inks; waiting breathes, failure blinks twice once, off stays dark. Reduced motion holds steady.

components.name: line-handles
components.title: Line handles
components.description: The presence of a drawn line or arrow: a green halo and end dots on hover, two end handles when selected; the connector's selection language.

components.name: link
components.title: Link
components.description: An inline destination with a persistent engraved underline, directional hover emphasis, press travel, current/unavailable/visited/loading states, and external/download glyphs.

components.name: link-card
components.title: Link card
components.description: A link as a glass object: the host and path on a screen tinted by the host, a LINK tag and one OPEN action.

react.base: none (a group; OPEN is the only link)

components.name: mark
components.title: Mark
components.description: Inline, metric-neutral text marks: dated and quiet underlines, a tag pill, a derived-tag ring, a hex underline with its swatch, a URL host pill, an inferred pill, the urgency LED and a trailing glyph.

react.export: Mark, MarkLine, tagIdentity, tagColor, MarkUrl, MarkInferred, MarkUrgency, MarkLife (Cue*)

swift.symbol: MetalCueText, MetalCueTag, MetalCueURLPill, MetalCueInferred, MetalCueUrgency, MetalCueLife, Text.metalCue(_:)

components.name: menu
components.title: Menu and correction popover
components.description: A frosted plate of 30 rows (frost-strong at .92, radius 18, padding 6, at least 200 wide) from a trigger or at the pointer: an engraved heading says what it acts on, pointer and keyboard share one highlight, keys at the right, destructive rows red, engraved separators; fades on settle. The correction popover is its right-click form. Built on Base UI Menu and Context Menu.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: An app's commands under a few words across the top: quiet keys that open the menu's plates; while one is open, a highlight glides between the keys on the settle spring and the next menu opens at once.

components.name: meter
components.title: Meter
components.description: A level in a range as a row of LED segments coloured by position (green, amber, red); a change sweeps segment by segment from the old edge to the new.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.title: Navigation menu
components.description: A site's sections across the top with panels of links: the plate rises on the surface spring, slides and resizes between keys on the settle spring, and its content moves the way you went.

components.name: number-field
components.title: Number field
components.description: A number you step, scrub or type: keycaps at each end of a pill well; each step turns the value one drum step (plus up, minus down) and an arrow past a limit shakes only the digits.

components.name: numeric-cue
components.title: Numeric cue
components.description: A bounded canonical quantity operated inline: vertical detent scrub, typed spinbutton and horizontal unit conversion. Explicit font footprint and one source transaction per gesture.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Moving through pages of results: page numbers in the switcher's track with previous and next shared-chevron keys; the current page's thumb glides to the chosen page on the part spring.

react.base: nav; the switcher's track and sliding thumb

components.name: past-banner
components.title: Past banner
components.description: The only chrome that changes while the canvas is scrubbed into the past: Surface(graphite-plain) with the MEMORY engraving, the moment viewed, and a Back to Now cap with its key.

components.name: perfect-preview
components.title: Perfect preview
components.description: Hold to perfect: while the pen is held still after a rough stroke, the fitted clean shape draws itself round as a faint green outline over 450 ms; when it closes the host morphs the stroke into the shape.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A small panel that comes out of its trigger: the menu's frosted plate rising one nest from the trigger's side on the surface spring, fading out on release without travelling back.

components.name: preview-card
components.title: Preview card
components.description: What is behind a link, seen by resting on it: after a steady hover the popover's plate rises out of the link with an image, title, description and host; it lingers so you can move onto it.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: Task amount and explicit idle, running, paused, failed, cancelled and complete states. Bars, slim bars, rings, segmented steps and buffered tracks share one contract; Reset drains on release and values turn on the drum.

components.name: provenance-tooltip
components.title: Provenance tooltip
components.description: One hover away from every cue: a wrapped Tooltip that says where the cue came from (Rule · date parser, Recognizer · 0.82, You), the detail in Tooltip.Dim, with the number whenever the app guessed.

components.name: radio
components.title: Radio group
components.description: One choice from a short list: round wells beside their labels; pressing darkens the well, releasing latches a pip in on the part spring while the old choice's pip drops out (the preset-button interlock).

components.name: region
components.title: Region
components.description: A drawn rectangle with a name that carries a rule: Well(region) with a head (Label name, Label rule, Label count) that lights as a drop target, dims, hides in the past and renames in place; a pinned lens is Surface(lens) with Row(list) rows.

react.base: none (a group; its rows and checkboxes are real controls)

components.name: rename-editor
components.title: Rename editor
components.description: A name field and one async rename confirm: basename selection, host validation, pending lock, glyph/drum result and captured-original Undo callback.

components.name: row
components.title: Row
components.description: A list, panel or option row; selection raises its plate, opened detail marks its rail, and completion strikes its text.

components.name: rule
components.title: Rule
components.description: An engraved groove between groups; graphite on dark chrome.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll area
components.description: A region that scrolls with the system's own scrollbar: a slim thumb that fades in while scrolling and widens when reached for, and edge fades that show there is more.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: One value from a list of named options: a raised cap showing the value and an up-down chevron, opening the menu's frosted list with the chosen row over the trigger; the chosen row carries the latched green LED.

components.name: selection-frame
components.title: Selection frame
components.description: The one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.

react.base: none (an object; the host carries aria-selected)

components.name: settings
components.title: Settings
components.description: An app's settings as sections of rows: an engraved heading over a raised card; each row a name, an optional detail and one control on the right; engraved rules between rows; shortcut rows with keycaps.

components.name: sheet
components.title: Sheet
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge (right or bottom) on the surface spring, follows a drag one to one, and leaves on release, sooner for a harder flick.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: Sidebar
components.description: An app's side place for moving between places: sections of items with one highlight that glides to the current place; it collapses to a rail (words first, then width) with tooltips.

components.name: size-readout
components.title: Size readout
components.description: A graphite pill that reads a measured value: an object's size, a multi-selection's count, a copy, a zoom level. Surface(graphite-deep) with a live Led and the value in Label(readout).

react.base: none (a readout; aria-hidden where it repeats what the object states)

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Where content will be before it arrives: blocks, lines and circles in the well's sunk look, shown after a beat with a soft sheen, swapped for the content on the settle spring.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Scalar or range amounts on a clamped track: horizontal/vertical, centred or neutral fill, named independent knobs, step detents, transient value bubble, drum readout and volume/brightness glyphs. Base UI preserves keyboard and form behavior.

components.name: snap-guides
components.title: Snap guides
components.description: The lines that explain a snap while a person moves or resizes on the canvas: 1 pt intent green, solid for aligned edges, dashed for aligned centres, spanning the aligned objects plus 8 pt, the same on screen at every zoom.

react.base: none (decorative; aria-hidden: the snap itself is the fact)

components.name: sparkline
components.title: Sparkline
components.description: A small series plot: a line with gaps, dots, the last point emphasised, a dashed baseline at the average.

components.name: spatial-field
components.title: Spatial field
components.description: One quiet, content-aware dot field for a Place. It yields to object footprints and reinforces the host-selected Region while the host retains placement authority.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: Unknown work in a host glyph slot: current ink, delayed arrival and minimum visibility. Large hosts show their incoming shape; known amounts use Progress.

components.name: split-pane
components.title: Split pane
components.description: Two places with a divider you can move: dragged one to one, it snaps to the default size or shut on the part spring; keys step it on settle.

react.base: div role=separator (the ARIA window splitter pattern)

components.name: status
components.title: Status badge
components.description: A readable 26pt status plate with words and a sunk LED or retained morphing meaning glyph. Quiet, opaque strong tint, explicit transparent/frosted surfaces and a solid override. State gestures have reduced-motion alternatives.

components.name: suggestion-chip
components.title: Suggestion chip
components.description: One question the recognizer asks at middle confidence, beside its block: Chip(suggestion) with the question, its confidence as a small engraving, and mini accept and dismiss buttons. Faint until the block is hovered.

components.name: surface
components.title: Surface
components.description: A raised plate or card from a material recipe: raise, raise-lite, raise-sm, frost, plate, panel, pop, tip, lens and the graphites.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once: a sunk pill track with a raised thumb that slides on the part spring; on, the track fills soft green.

components.name: switcher
components.title: Switcher
components.description: A pill of pills on Base UI RadioGroup: a well track, options on the height ladder, and a raised thumb that glides to the selection on the part spring.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Rows of things, read across and compared down: engraved labels and hairlines; sorting turns the column's arrow and every row travels to its new place on the settle spring; rows select with the checkbox.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switches which panel is shown: the switcher track and gliding thumb as the tab list, and panels that drift in from the side the thumb went.

components.name: tag-cue
components.title: Tag cue
components.description: Recent source tags cycle with canonical identity colour; a shared autocomplete chooses tags for a captured unfinished hash range.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: Several lines of text in the field well that grows with what is written on the settle spring; with a limit, a counter fades in near it and shakes on the refusal spring when writing goes past it.

components.name: time-scrubber
components.title: Time scrubber
components.description: Time as a dimension of the surface: a Slider (track, moment marks, day ticks, knurled knob) under an engraved readout with NOW as Button(link) while in the past. Formerly MemoryScrubber.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: The result of a person's own action, with Undo: a 44 tall smoked pill at the bottom centre. Results stack as a deck in depth, newest in front; pointing fans it out, a swipe dismisses, a repeat counts. Built on Base UI Toast. Retained updates and promise results morph their authored glyph and label in place, preserving card identity and dismissal.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A latching push button: the button cap with a lamp; pressing sinks it past the catch, releasing into on settles it at the latch on the part spring with the lamp lit. Toggle group puts the keys in a row.

components.name: tool-strip
components.title: Tool strip
components.description: Selection-aware graphite action strip: stable verb intersections, glyph keys and count, anchored collision placement, More overflow, disabled reasons, waiting feedback and held irreversible actions.

components.name: toolbar
components.title: Toolbar and tool button
components.description: A frosted capsule strip of circular 36 tool caps (frost in the colorway, or graphite), latched tools pressed with a green LED, engraved separators, a search well, and tooltips with the key. Built on Base UI Toolbar, Toggle and Tooltip.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Names an icon-only control and its key: a graphite pill chip in the label role, SELECT · V with the key dimmed, 10 from the trigger after 120 ms, grouped so the next trigger shows at once; flips near the edge; fades on settle. Built on Base UI Tooltip. wrap makes a longer note that wraps at 280 with its detail in Tooltip.Dim.

components.name: weather
components.title: Weather
components.description: Weather as an object: a slab with a dot-matrix sky sunk into it that follows the time of day, the temperature in the pixel face on its ground, the next hours and the week as dot ranges on one scale; and a small tile of one sky.

react.export: Weather, WeatherTile, WeatherGlyph, WEATHER_SKIES, weatherScene, moonAge, moonPhaseName
react.base: none (a region with a label; the sky is an image to a screen reader)

components.name: well
components.title: Well
components.description: A sunk field or track: field, track, region (with a drop-target state) and graphite.
